questions.question: What is kinetic energy?
choices: Energy contained only in chemical fuels
Energy lost whenever an object is stationary

questions.question: What is gravitational potential energy near Earth's surface?
choices: Energy associated with position in a gravitational field
Energy unrelated to an object's mass

questions.question: What is the SI unit of energy and work?
What is power?
choices: The rate of energy transfer or work

questions.question: Which unit is used for power?
What is mechanical energy in a simple introductory model?
choices: The sum of mass and distance
The sum of kinetic and potential energy

questions.question: What does conservation of energy state?
choices: Energy is created whenever motion begins
Every object has constant kinetic energy
Energy is transferred or transformed, not created or destroyed

questions.question: When does a force do positive work on an object?
choices: When it has a component in the direction of displacement
When it is perpendicular to every displacement
When displacement is opposite its direction

questions.question: Why can friction reduce mechanical energy without violating energy conservation?
choices: Mechanical energy is converted into other forms, including thermal energy
Conservation applies only to objects without surfaces
Lost mechanical energy has no destination

questions.question: How does doubling speed affect kinetic energy if mass stays constant?
How does raising an object increase gravitational potential energy near Earth's surface?
choices: Work against gravity transfers energy into the object-Earth system

questions.question: Why can two machines perform equal work but have different power?
choices: Power is the total work regardless of time
Power depends only on the force used
They can take different amounts of time

questions.question: What happens to stored elastic energy when a compressed spring launches an object?
choices: Some can be transferred to the object's kinetic energy
It all becomes additional mass in ordinary mechanics
It remains unchanged regardless of the launch
It must become gravitational energy only

questions.question: Why is a machine's useful energy output usually less than its total energy input?
choices: The machine creates energy only during startup
Some input energy goes to less useful forms such as heating
Output energy is always measured in different units

questions.question: What does efficiency compare?
choices: Useful output energy with total input energy
